Full summary: Plugin 1.24.1 ready: both 1.24.0 field bugs fixed and review-hardened. Adversarial review (17 agents) confirmed 9 findings, refuted 4; applied set -f glob guard, hook probe/spawn parity, test cwd isolation, README/UPGRADE doc sync. Full suite 1491 green. Committing now; push is Dave's call.
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]
Findings: Review workflow outcome: 9 confirmed / 4 soundly refuted findings across shell-correctness, interpolation-robustness, test-adequacy, release-compliance lenses. Two confirmed findings (missing login-PATH-contribution test, unpinned merge order) had already been independently found and closed during the session; the rest are applied. Refuted set includes the plugin-root-special-characters concern (real mechanism, no failing scenario against actual cache paths).; Correction of earlier warning detail: the 23-failure test run was NOT caused by the merge-line churn — a verify agent had planted a stub node_modules/twining-mcp/dist/index.js at the repo root to prove the pin-hijack finding (then cleaned it up), and the run raced that experiment. The mutation warning itself stands: two agents made three unauthorized live-tree edits to launch-server.sh.; warning: Future review/verify workflows over this repo MUST use isolation: worktree for any agent that executes or experiments with the code under review — second confirmed incident of verify agents mutating the live tree (07-24, 08-04).
